findings.pdf_says: In the 4.3.2 OPEN general format a drawn box encloses both the INPUT phrase's bracket [REVERSED / WITH NO REWIND] and the OUTPUT phrase's [WITH NO REWIND] (one box spanning the two lines), the same box notation that encloses 'EXTEND {file-name-4} ...'.
findings.why_it_matters: The transcription keeps the box marker (║) around the EXTEND line but drops the box around the REVERSED / WITH NO REWIND bracket and the OUTPUT [WITH NO REWIND] bracket, so the figure no longer shows that these phrases are boxed (higher-level/obsolete-marked) elements. Syntax itself (brackets, braces, ellipses, underlining) is otherwise faithful.
